# Signalith 0.3.2

- The OpenSearch card on the Servers page shows the shards in use against `cluster.max_shards_per_node`, and warns when OpenSearch holds, or at today's data models and retention will hold, 80% of the shards it allows, on one node too. When OpenSearch refuses a new day's index for lack of shards, the server log says so and senders are asked to send the events again instead of losing them. See [Server settings](https://signalith.io/docs/settings/).
